from app.notifications.sms_text import format_sms_alert
from app.notifications.alert_policy import enrich_issues

def merge_live_sensor_issues(issues, live):
    """Use the integrated Pi cache for SMS incidents, without changing actuation."""
    sensors = live.get("sensors") if isinstance(live, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(sensors, dict):
        return issues
    for name in ("ph", "ec", "water_temperature", "turbidity", "ambient_humidity"):
        sensor = sensors.get(name)
        if not isinstance(sensor, dict):
            continue
        key = f"sensor:{name}:status"
        # Legacy adapters are intentionally disabled on Pi to avoid a second
        # hardware owner. Their pending status must not become a GSM event.
        issues.pop(key, None)
        status = str(sensor.get("status") or "")
        failures = sensor.get("consecutive_failures", 0)
        persistent = (isinstance(failures, int) and not isinstance(failures, bool)
                      and failures >= 2)
        if status.startswith("ERROR") or (sensor.get("valid") is False and persistent):
            issues[key] = {
                "source": "sensor", "severity": "critical",
                "message": f"{SENSOR_LABELS[name]} is not working. Please check its connection.",
                "diagnostic": status,
            }
    return issues
